0.intro: Sunday. Ten hours on a bus, plus one the clock stole at the border. The host families were waiting with signs. Mine said VINICIUS, no accent, which is fair.
0.outro: Under the pillow: a tarot card. The Fool. A traveller with a bag stepping off a cliff, a small white dog at his heels. On the back, a riddle in Spanish. Txuri is watching me from the doorway.

1.intro: Monday. IES Sarriguren. Nobody understands me yet, but a basketball is a basketball in any language.
1.outro: Viagens na Terra dos Outros, page two. The riddle on the card mentions a star with five points and a wall. Tomorrow: Pamplona.

default.outro: (The rest of the week is not in this build yet. Tomorrow will look a lot like today, which is also how weeks work.)
